description:
Create a hydraulic circuit diagram for a forklift lift system using the ISO 1219 standard symbols found in draw.io's 'Fluid Power' shape library.

Scenario:
A Mechanical Engineer needs a schematic for the service manual of a Series-X Forklift. You are provided with the system specifications in a text file on the Desktop (`~/Desktop/hydraulic_specs.txt`).

Task Steps:
1. Enable the 'Fluid Power' shape library (go to More Shapes > Engineering > Fluid Power).
2. Create a schematic containing these components:
   - Reservoir (Tank)
   - Fixed Displacement Pump driven by an Electric Motor
   - Pressure Relief Valve (Safety)
   - 4-Way, 3-Position Directional Control Valve (Lever operated, Spring Centered)
   - Double-Acting Cylinder (Lift Cylinder)
   - Return Line Filter
3. Connect the components with lines to show flow:
   - Pump draws from Tank and feeds the Valve (Pressure Line)
   - Relief Valve bridges Pressure Line to Tank
   - Valve connects to both ends of the Cylinder
   - Valve exhaust goes through Filter back to Tank
4. Label the main components (e.g., 'Pump', 'Lift Cylinder', 'Relief Valve').
5. Save the diagram as `~/Desktop/forklift_hydraulic.drawio`.
6. Export the diagram as a PNG image to `~/Desktop/forklift_hydraulic.png`.

CRITICAL: You MUST use the specific engineering symbols from the Fluid Power library, not generic rectangles.
